senses.gloss: to strike against, come in contact with, meet; (in a hostile sense) to attack, strike. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 4 כיון שפ׳ בעשו when he met Esau.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75:10">Gen. R. s. 75</cite> <he>פ׳ בלובשי ברזל</he> he met those clad in iron armor.
<cite ref="Sukkah 52b:2">Succ. 52ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אם פ׳ בך מנוול זה</he>, v. <cite ref="N00324"><he>נָוַול</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:12:10">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ולמה לא פָּגַעְתָּה בו</he> (not <cite ref="B00537"><he>ביה</he></cite>) why didst thou not connect thyself with him? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:6">Num. R. s. 5</cite> <he>כדי שלא תִפְגַּע בכולם מדת הדין וכ׳</he> (not <he>יפגע</he>) in order that divine justice might not strike all of them, he took half of his name (the letter <cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>) &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>, end <he>בקשה … לִפְגּוֹעַ במשה</he> divine justice wanted to strike Moses.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:11">Koh. R. to IX, 11</cite> <he>עת היא שפּוֹגַעַת באדם וכ׳</he> (not <he>האדם</he>), v. <cite ref="P01420"><he>עִרְעֵר</he> III</cite>.
Gen. R. s. 68 (ref. to Gen. XXVIII, 11) וַיִּפְגַּע במקום … מפני מה וכ׳ ‘and he entreated the Lord’ … why is the Lord surnamed maḳom? (v. מָקוֹם).
Ib. מהו ויפגע במקום צלי וכ׳ what does vayifgʿa bammaḳom mean? He prayed on the site of the Temple; a. e.—Part. pass. פָּגוּעַ; pl. פְּגוּעִין stricken, afflicted (with insanity).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:16">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="Q00087"><he>פֶּגַע</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be stricken; to suffer. Ib. משנ׳ after one has been stricken; Y. Erub. X, 26ᶜ bot.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 14b">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:3">Tosef. ib. II, 3</cite> <he>הציץ ונ׳</he> he looked (into the divine secrets, v. <cite ref="Q01590"><he>פַּרְדֵּס</he></cite>) and became demented; Y. ib. II, 77ᵇ top.
<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:6">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>אין שוטה נ׳</he> a maniac cannot be stricken with dementia (one overladen with sorrows becomes indifferent to new afflictions); a. e.

senses.gloss: to suffer. Koh. R. l. c. עת … והוא מַפְגִּיעַ time strikes man …, and he suffers, v. עִרְעֵר III.
to entreat. Ib. פעמים שאדם מפגיע וכ׳ at times man prays and is answered &c.
